bibliographic_scope.title: Employing End-Functional Polythiophene To Control the Morphology of Nanocrystal–Polymer Composites in Hybrid Solar Cells
bibliographic_scope.authors: Jinsong Liu; Toru Tanaka; Kevin Sivula; A. Paul Alivisatos; Jean M. J. Fréchet
bibliographic_scope.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

interpretations.text: The main article alone summarizes preparation; the locally identity-matched SI supplies polymer intermediates, CdSe growth, ligand exchange, TEM films, devices and measurement procedures. Its identity is checked, but it has no separate strict-screen PASS. Full cited works remain unreviewed.

Polymer 1 has H/Br ends. Coupling with organotin compound 2 gives cyano-end polymer 3; LiAlH4 reduction gives amino-end polymer 4. NMR and MALDI support end-group conversion; no atomistic polymer conformation is measured.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 1–5, Polymer preparations and Figures 1–2

interpretations.text: The polymer 3 procedure prints 0.4 mg polymer 1 (~0.054 mmol), yet yields 0.37 g at 94%. Polymer 4 acidification prints 0.5 mL of 2 M HCl followed by 1 mL. The package retains these conflicts and does not repair either dose. Main p. 1, Scheme 1 labels toluene/DMF as 4:1, whereas SI pp. 2–3 specify 40 mL toluene and 8 mL DMF for polymer 3. This unresolved discrepancy is retained; neither stated charge is changed to enforce the scheme ratio.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 2–3, Polymer 3 and 4 preparation; Main PDF p. 1, Scheme 1

interpretations.text: The detailed SI loads CdO, TDPA and TOPO, heats until clear, adds TOP and injects selenium/TOP at 300 °C, then grows at 290 °C for 5 min. Main p. 1 instead summarizes CdO and Se solution injection. The detailed operational sequence is retained while both descriptions remain documented. About 7 nm diameter and 30 nm length are TEM estimates, not a unit cell or film-specific size.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1, CdSe preparation and dimensions

interpretations.text: The whole rod batch is refluxed in pyridine for 24 h under argon. After workup, 15–20 mg/mL nanocrystal dispersion is mixed with 15.0 mg/mL polymer solution in pyridine/chloroform 1:9 v/v. Individual blend aliquots are unreported; the stock concentration range is not a value for every specimen.

SI thin films use 2000 rpm and 5 or 12 vol% CdSe; thicker films use 1000 rpm and 12, 26 or 43 vol%. Main Figure 1 separately labels 20 or 40 wt%. No weight-to-volume conversion or exact cross-document physical-sample identity is asserted. Source film thicknesses and spin times are unreported.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 7–8, TEM and Figures 3–4

interpretations.text: The source describes more homogeneous dispersion and no visible aggregation with amino-end polymer 4, versus phase separation with polymer 1, in both thinner and thicker films. Amino coordination partially replacing pyridine and larger interfacial area are proposed explanations, not directly measured coordination or charge-separation rates.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Morphology and interpretation

interpretations.text: The source reports higher efficiency and current density for polymer 4, with similar fill factors. Favored CdSe ratios are approximately 40 vol% for polymer 4 and 65 vol% for polymer 1. These are source-interpreted optima, not newly reconstructed growth batches. UV–vis spectra of the two active films are described as essentially identical. No graph-only PCE, voltage, current or fill-factor points are digitized.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Device discussion and Figure 2
SI PDF p. 9–11, Performance and Figures 5–8

interpretations.text: General MALDI text gives 20 keV acceleration, whereas SI Figure 2 says 2000 V. SI Figure 6 caption repeats open-circuit voltage, while its axes/title and p. 9 identify current density. SI Figure 7 labels FF (%) with fractional-looking values. Original labels are retained; no correction or percent conversion is performed. SI p. 9 prints FF = max{J*V} / Jsc* Voc without denominator parentheses. The denominator grouping is unresolved in the printed typography; no fill factor is calculated. Figure 7 percent-axis ambiguity is retained.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 1, 5, 9–11, MALDI and device figure captions

interpretations.text: Compound 2 elemental analysis: calculated C 35.33, H 4.08, N 5.15, S 11.79, Sn 43.65%; found C 35.30, H 4.12, N 5.16, S 11.78%; no found Sn value. Its 1H NMR in CDCl3: δ 7.70 (d, J 3.6 Hz, 1H), 7.16 (d, J 3.6 Hz, 1H), 0.43 (s, 9H). Polymer 3 has δ 7.58 and 7.11 (each d, J 3.9 Hz); polymer 4 has the end-group singlet at δ 4.10. These do not supply nanocrystal phase or coordinates.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 2–4, Elemental analysis, NMR and Figure 1

source_conflicts: SI p. 2 prints polymer 1 feed as 0.4 mg (~0.054 mmol) for polymer 3, while SI p. 3 reports 0.37 g product at 94% yield. The feed mass is retained literally, not repaired to 0.4 g.
SI p. 3 prints aqueous HCl as 0.5 mL of 2 M solution followed by 1 mL. Its actual addition volume is unresolved; neither alternative is silently selected.
SI p. 1 gives MALDI acceleration as 20 keV; SI Figure 2 caption gives 2000 V. Both source statements are retained.
Main Figure 1 labels 20 and 40 wt% CdSe; SI Figure 3 labels 5 and 12 vol%. No density conversion or panel-level physical-sample equivalence is asserted.

SI Figure 6 caption calls the plot open-circuit voltage, but its axes/title and SI p. 9 identify short-circuit current density. SI Figure 7 labels FF (%) while showing fractional-looking ordinate values; no conversion is applied.

Main p. 1 summarizes CdO and Se solution injection, while SI p. 6 explicitly loads CdO before injecting selenium in TOP. The detailed SI sequence is used for the operational recipe, with the main narrative retained as a source discrepancy.
limitations: Two main pages and eleven locally identity-matched SI pages read completely; cited full works unreviewed. Main has an existing strict-screen PASS; SI identity is verified but no separate strict-screen PASS is claimed.
The source contains unresolved polymer feed-mass, HCl-volume, MALDI-setting and figure-label conflicts. Printed alternatives remain visible.
TEM film thicknesses, spin-coating duration, individual mixing aliquots and film-specific nanorod dimensions are unreported. Main weight fractions are not silently converted into SI volume fractions.

CdSe crystal phase, refined unit cell, atomic coordinates, exact size uncertainty and particle population are unreported. Identity cards and stage diagrams are illustrative, not measured molecular or particle structures.
